content:
I am thrilled to announce that I have recently been appointed as a member of the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! Having worked with the standard since 2017, it is an honor to have the opportunity to help move the standard forward and contribute to its continued success. 

If you are already using CDS Hooks, I encourage you to add your implementation to the project's wiki page at https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability. This will not only showcase your commitment to interoperability but also help others in the community learn from your experience.

If you are not yet using CDS Hooks and are interested in implementing the standard in your organization, I am here to help as a freelance consultant. I have hands-on experience with the standard and can assist you in implementing it effectively.

Let's work together to advance interoperability in healthcare and improve patient outcomes through the use of CDS Hooks! #CDSHooks #ProjectManagement #HealthTech #Interoperability.
